nodes.name: AdminCustomerController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes admin-only REST endpoints for listing, searching, filtering, reading, and updating customer profiles. It delegates customer business operations to CustomerService and returns paginated CustomerResponse DTOs.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring MVC controller secured with method-level role authorization.

nodes.name: CustomerUpdateRequest.java
nodes.summary: Defines the request payload for administrator customer profile updates, including identity details, loyalty level, points, and spending totals. The record is used by the customer service update workflow.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record used as an immutable request DTO.

nodes.name: CustomerResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the customer response projection returned by admin customer APIs. Its factory method maps Customer entity and related user identity fields into an API-safe DTO.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record with a static entity-to-DTO mapper.

nodes.name: Customer.java
nodes.summary: Models customer profile data persisted in the database, including one-to-one user ownership, contact details, loyalty status, points, and lifetime spending. It supplies the entity backing admin customer management and response mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: JPA entity using Lombok and enum mapping for loyalty level.

nodes.name: CustomerLevel.java
nodes.summary: Defines the customer loyalty tiers used by customer records, filters, and update requests. The enum centralizes allowed values for level-based customer segmentation.

nodes.name: CustomerRepository.java
nodes.summary: Provides Spring Data access for Customer entities, including lookup by user id, level filtering, and name or phone search projections. It bridges customer service logic to persistent customer records.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring Data repository combines derived queries with a JPQL projection query.

nodes.name: CustomerService.java
nodes.summary: Declares the customer management service contract for pagination, level filtering, profile lookup, search, and updates. Admin controllers depend on this interface rather than the concrete implementation.

nodes.name: CustomerServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements customer management operations by querying CustomerRepository, mapping entities to CustomerResponse DTOs, and applying partial profile updates. It enforces missing-customer handling through ResourceNotFoundException.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring service uses read-only transactions for queries and a write transaction for partial updates.

nodes.name: AdminCustomerController
nodes.summary: Spring REST controller for administrator customer operations under /api/v1/admin/customers. It exposes five endpoints and delegates all business behavior to CustomerService.

nodes.name: getAllCustomers
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated view of all customer profiles for administrators.

nodes.name: searchCustomers
nodes.summary: Searches customers by optional name and phone filters with pagination.

nodes.name: getByLevel
nodes.summary: Returns customers filtered by a specific loyalty level.

nodes.name: getByUserId
nodes.summary: Fetches a single customer profile by associated user id.

nodes.name: updateCustomer
nodes.summary: Accepts a validated update request and returns the updated customer profile.

nodes.name: CustomerUpdateRequest
nodes.summary: Immutable request DTO carrying optional customer fields that an administrator may update. It includes loyalty and spending fields alongside profile metadata.

nodes.name: CustomerResponse
nodes.summary: Immutable response DTO combining customer profile data with selected user identity fields. It encapsulates conversion from the Customer entity.

nodes.name: fromEntity
nodes.summary: Maps a Customer entity and its related User into a CustomerResponse record for API responses.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.summary: JPA entity representing customer profile and loyalty data associated with a User. It stores contact fields, loyalty tier, points, and total spending.

nodes.name: CustomerLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of supported customer loyalty levels used in persistence, requests, and filtering.

nodes.name: CustomerRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository interface for Customer persistence and customer search queries. It provides user-id lookup, loyalty-level filtering, and DTO projection search.

nodes.name: CustomerService
nodes.summary: Service interface defining customer management operations consumed by admin controllers. It abstracts pagination, filtering, lookup, search, and updates.

nodes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete CustomerService implementation backed by CustomerRepository. It maps query results to DTOs and applies transactional partial updates to customer entities.

nodes.name: getAllCustomers
nodes.summary: Loads all customers through the repository and maps each entity to CustomerResponse.

nodes.name: getCustomersByLevel
nodes.summary: Loads customers by loyalty level and maps the paginated results to response DTOs.

nodes.name: getCustomerByUserId
nodes.summary: Finds a customer by user id and converts it to a response DTO.

nodes.name: searchCustomers
nodes.summary: Runs repository search by customer name or phone and returns projected response DTOs.

nodes.name: updateCustomer
nodes.summary: Applies non-null update fields to a customer entity and returns the updated response DTO.
